# Homepage — rules for this repo

## Generated images are marked "Generated by Claude"

Every image generated here must say **"Generated by Claude"** inside the image, in the
**bottom-right corner**. This covers computed, drawn and composed pictures alike, such
as the Research-interests figures and any future illustration. It does not cover
figures taken from the author's own papers or talks, or photographs.

- Make figures with `assets/interests/src/figstyle.py`: `fs.save()` stamps the text
  automatically (`credit()`). Do not bypass `fs.save()`.
- If an image is made any other way (PIL, SVG, another library), add the same text in
  the same place before it is used anywhere.
- After generating, look at the image and check that the stamp is readable and does
  not cover a label.

## No identifiable people in images

Do not put photographs of identifiable people on the site. This includes faces inside
figures reproduced from papers: one inpainting example showed a person's face and was
replaced by another figure from the same paper. The author's own profile photo is the
only exception.

## This repo is public

Nothing personal about other people goes in it: no co-author e-mail addresses, no
private server addresses, no unpublished material. `scan_papers.py` keeps paper
abstracts and the e-mail addresses found in them in `data/papers.local.json`, which
`.gitignore` excludes. Check before adding a new data file.

## The site

Edit `data/*.json`, then run `python build/render.py`. Never edit `docs/` by hand; it is
regenerated on every build. See [README.md](README.md).
